programme.title: Discovering Guizhou: The Red Hot recipe
programme.desc: Guizhou Province has long been known for its rugged landscapes and ethnic diversity, but today, it's making headlines for something else: the red hot chili peppers. Yes, Round Table is still in Guizhou province, and in this episode, we take you to see a city's fiery pepper boom!

programme.title: RAZOR: DNA Archaeology
programme.desc: In this edition of RAZOR, Neil Cairns investigates a breakthrough known as "DNA archaeology" — a non-destructive way of retrieving ancient human DNA from Paleolithic tools. At La Grande Roche cave in France, archaeologist Dr. Marie Soressi shows how stone artifacts can now be directly linked to the people who once used them. In Leipzig, geneticist Elena Essel demonstrates the delicate extraction process inside a contamination-free clean lab, soaking artifacts in a phosphate buffer to release microscopic DNA fragments without damaging the object. Finally, Dr. Matthias Meyer analyses the sequences against modern reference genomes, uncovering details of sex, ancestry, and social patterns in...

programme.title: RAZOR: Sustainable Fishing Technology
programme.desc: Around 40% of marine life caught at sea are unintended species — a problem known as bycatch — which kills or discards an estimated 40 million tonnes of fish and threatens endangered animals such as dolphins, sea turtles and sharks. In this edition of RAZOR, Reya El-Salahi travels to western Scotland to meet fisherman Ian Wightman, who is trialling new high-tech gear designed to cut bycatch and boost his income. Created by SafetyNet Technologies, the devices combine cameras, sensors and lights that deter non-target species, while also collecting data on climate change and the impact of trawling on seabeds. At the company's London base in Somerset House, CTO Aran Dasan and his team refine...

programme.title: Discovering Guizhou: Miao culture extravaganza
programme.desc: What do spicy peppers, handmade guitars, and green cities have in common? Guizhou. In our new on-the-ground mini-series ChinaHorizons, we invite you to join our trip to Guizhou province. For the first stop, we record our podcast in a traditional Miao people's village cluster to appreciate diversified cultures, intangible cultural heritage items and delicious local cuisines.

programme.title: RAZOR: DNA Archaeology
programme.desc: In this edition of RAZOR, Neil Cairns investigates a breakthrough known as "DNA archaeology" — a non-destructive way of retrieving ancient human DNA from Paleolithic tools. At La Grande Roche cave in France, archaeologist Dr. Marie Soressi shows how stone artifacts can now be directly linked to the people who once used them. In Leipzig, geneticist Elena Essel demonstrates the delicate extraction process inside a contamination-free clean lab, soaking artifacts in a phosphate buffer to release microscopic DNA fragments without damaging the object. Finally, Dr. Matthias Meyer analyses the sequences against modern reference genomes, uncovering details of sex, ancestry, and social patterns in...

programme.title: RAZOR: Sustainable Fishing Technology
programme.desc: Around 40% of marine life caught at sea are unintended species — a problem known as bycatch — which kills or discards an estimated 40 million tonnes of fish and threatens endangered animals such as dolphins, sea turtles and sharks. In this edition of RAZOR, Reya El-Salahi travels to western Scotland to meet fisherman Ian Wightman, who is trialling new high-tech gear designed to cut bycatch and boost his income. Created by SafetyNet Technologies, the devices combine cameras, sensors and lights that deter non-target species, while also collecting data on climate change and the impact of trawling on seabeds. At the company's London base in Somerset House, CTO Aran Dasan and his team refine...

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 South West Portugal: Alentejano and Costa Vicentina
programme.desc: In the southwest of Portugal lies the little known Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina. It encompasses a narrow coastal strip that runs along the coast to the south of Portugal. Sparsely populated, this coastal region, which was placed under protection in 1988, is considered one of the last intact ecosystems in Europe. The steep cliffs, the almost constant wind and high waves have ensured that mass tourism has not gained a foothold here. There are still near-natural forests and a diverse bird life.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The "Parque Natural da Ria Formosa" is one of the largest lagoon conservation areas in Europe. Bordered by five natural islands. A mosaic of sandbanks, brackish and freshwater lagoons and salt marshes. In 2010, the "Ria Formosa" was chosen as one of the seven natural wonders of Portugal. It is a unique ecosystem: in the winter months, more than 20,000 birds gather here. In addition, the nature park has one of the largest seahorse populations internationally. More than half of all fish species in the Atlantic are said to spawn in the lagoon.

programme.title: Darkwoods - Where Nature Survives
programme.desc: Half a century ago the German Duke Carl von Württemberg purchased a 55.000-hectare parcel of land in the Selkirk Mountains in British Columbia, Canada. He baptized his holdings after his native Black Forest, "Darkwoods", and managed the forests in the lonely region sustainably.

programme.title: The Canary Islands - In the Shadows of the Volcanoes
programme.desc: The Canary Islands were born in the depths of the ocean. Forged by fire and sculpted by winds and waves, this volcanic land offers landscapes of colossal force and almost unreal beauty.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Wild Moments: 4 Seasons - Autumn & Winter
programme.desc: In accordance with the seasons and with deep respect of nature, people all over the world celebrate their long-standing traditions. Near the outermost border of Europe, in Bashkiria, generations of bee keepers have collected honey from rare wild bees, the Burzyan bees. In Japan the last of the Usho catch fish with "living fishing rods": trained cormorants. Traditionally, they provided the Emperor's family with fresh fish. In Poland carp are fished from the ponds to provide everybody with carp for Christmas dinner - this is an old Polish tradition. In Frisia winter is driven out by fires at what is known as "Biikebrennen", and in Hungary the "Busho" - frightening characters wearing wooden...

programme.title: The Incredible Five - A Cheetah's Tale
programme.desc: Cheetahs are the high-speed hunters of the Savannah. Few attempt to take on larger prey than gazelles or smallish antelopes. But on occasion, the predatory cats reveal their surprisingly different side. In the Northern Serengeti, a group of male cheetahs emerges and turns all we know about them upside down. Males are usually loners or live in small groups, but here we have five tomcats hunting together as one. It is actually, the largest alliance of the animals ever seen! This film has many stories to tell about the sleek hunters.

programme.title: The Cape of Wild Animals, Episode 5
programme.desc: The movie focuses on committed animal rights activists, who fight for the lives of their charges every day, in diverse protection projects and rescue centres along the South African Garden Route.

programme.title: Close up with Hippos
programme.desc: This nature documentary shows the many different sides of the Hippo’s lives on one September day in two iconic African locations: the Masai Mara-Nationalpark in Kenya, also the setting for the largest annual animal migration on the planet – one and a half million wildebeests and zebras migrate from the Serengeti to Kenya during this time.

programme.desc: This is a story about a remote island in the pacific.

programme.title: Northern Woods
programme.desc: It is a musical film a a tributeto the Nordic forest: it shows its development from a primeval wood to a cultivated forest. Once populated by wild animals such as wolves, bears, eagles, deer and musk oxen, complex re-enactment-scenes shot by dollies and helicopters vividly depict the colonization of the forest by the Celts and Germans. But as time progressed, the northern forest has on numerous occasions fallen victim to environmental degradation and overexploitation. Several provisions were made to protect this wild beauty. The Helsinki resolution of 1993, which stipulated that the woods be used in a way and in a magnitude which guarantees their biological variety and productiveness and...

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the...

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: The moon disappears behind the horizon and the stage is set for a new day in the Alps of Berchtesgaden.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Wild Bavaria - In The Shadow of the Watzmann.
programme.desc: Mighty and mysterious, King Watzmann sits above Germany's only alpine national park.

programme.title: The Südheide - Woods, meadows, open country
programme.desc: Forests and fields, moors and heathland, shepherds and sheep - these are the symbols of an ostensibly unspoilt landscape that has inspired poets and painters alike for centuries. The secret of the almost 500 km² nature reserve Naturpark Südheide lies in its diversity: the origins of its soil, geology and topography can be traced back to the ice age. But the region between Hamburg and Hannover is anything but unspoilt. For centuries, it was synonymous with heathland farmers and formed as a North German cultivated landscape. This documentary tells of an almost unknown region, which has been strongly influenced by mankind for centuries, yet still remains diverse in its nature. Nature...

programme.title: Wild River Rhine
programme.desc: Alluvial forests, roaring waterfalls, steep canyons and sunny slopes flank the river Rhine. The variety of habitats is the reason for the large biodiversity along the stream.There is hardly any other river in Germany that is surrounded by as many myths and legends as the river Rhine. No other river has been the topic of songs, has been painted and travelled equally frequently. Despite this it still seems to be true today what the French poet Victor Hugo once said about this river – the Rhine is a river everybody talks about, nobody explores, everybody visits but no one really knows. The film follows the water against the stream. It starts at the river’s delta in the Netherlands, flows...

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field...

programme.title: Jacques Cousteau's Legacy - Return To The Undersea World
programme.desc: A composition of wildlife footage, archive material and elaborate re-enactments results in a brilliant reconstruction of the life of famed marine biologist and environmental pioneer Jacques Cousteau. On the trail of the most famous oceanographer of the 20th Century, the team spent two years filming original locations on three different continents, in four different oceans. The film charts how Cousteau’s outlook on the environment changed throughout his many decades at sea around the globe. On his personal journey to enlightenment, he changed from a man who killed sharks in hate and thoughtlessly blew up coral reefs, to a radical environmentalist.

programme.title: Passion for planet
programme.desc: The Canadian documentary filmmaker Rob Stewart wants to save our planet, to save us. Several times a week he dives with sharks that he finds more harmless as us humans. He travels throughout the country to present his underwater films, to prove why our oceans are worth fighting for. A change of scene; in Odisha, India, filmmaker Rita Banerji is busy shooting an impressive spectacle. Thousands of Olive Ridley turtles are making their way from the sea to lay their eggs on the beach. Just six weeks later and baby turtles the size of a human hand will inhabit the entire beach. Rita is ready and prepared with her equipment. But she is afraid that one day, India’s beaches will disappear and...

programme.title: Alpine Whistleblowers - On the Playground of the Marmots
programme.desc: These peculiar and roughly rabbit-sized rodents enjoy great popularity at the Großglockner in the Austrian Alps. Before the last ice age, marmots used to live in the lowland of Tirol, but with the melting of the glaciers they were driven higher up into the mountains – a trend that will continue given the current climate change. Today, they simply feel too warm below 800 meters. In spring, as soon as the temperatures begin to rise, marmots leave their dens after a nearly six-month long hibernation. After eating their share and recovering from the long fast, losing up to a third of their body weight, the most important thing is founding a family. And that sometimes involves rather fierce...

programme.title: Antarctica - Tales from the End of the World
programme.desc: The Antarctic region is undoubtedly one of the most remote and inhospitable, yet one of the most beautiful landscapes of the world. This documentary takes us on a journey to the stormy isolated islands of the Southern Ocean. Seals, penguins, seabirds and numerous other animals live and breed in this hostile environment and harsh climate. Only by an icebreaker can we reach the remote coasts of the Antarctic continent where Emperor Penguins defy the life-threatening environment of the vast ice desert at the end of the world.

programme.title: Survival of the Fittest in the Alps
programme.desc: The documentary shows the survival strategies of various animal species in the high mountains of the Alps in winter. Despite freezing temperatures and limited food supply, chamois, red deer and snow hares manage to survive the cold months. Latest research reveals the amazing abilities the animals have developed to adapt to the extreme conditions and also how climate change is altering the behaviour of the alpine inhabitants.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Wild Moments: Four Seasons - Spring & Summer
programme.desc: In accordance with the seasons and with deep respect of nature, people all over the world celebrate their long-standing traditions. In Japan the first picnics at the cherry blossom festival kick off the long-awaited outdoor season, while the Scots perform their Highland Games. In the summer the Latvians celebrate the biggest party of the year: midsummer night. The vast wildflower meadows provide them with wreathes of flowers which have magical healing powers; animals are provided with an abundance of insects. This enables the rare hoopoe to breed in Latvia. In the Spree forest region, an enchanting river landscape south-east of Berlin, farmers still harvest the famous Spreeforest...

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Wild Moments: Wildlife Warriors
programme.desc: All over the world men and women fight for the protection of nature reserves and endangered species. This is their story, a story of bravery and stamina. We visit scientists in Central Europe who monitor the offspring of the rare lynx nearly 200 years after these elusive cats were extinct in the wild. We follow the work of the moose detective in Sweden on the island of Oland who tries to solve the riddle of increasing numbers of dead moose calves. In the heart of Africa one woman and her guards try to protect rare lowland gorillas and forest elephants but the increasing bush meat trade and the ongoing ivory smuggling makes their work extremely dangerous. Last but not least we meet US...

programme.title: The Beavers are back
programme.desc: The return of the beavers is one of the greatest success stories of nature conservation in Germany. Hunted for a long time and almost exterminated, today more than 35.000 beavers live in Germany again – and the trend is rising. But how did this happen? One gets to see the mostly nocturnal animals only rarely. Klaus Weißmann has spent more than two years tracking down the shy beavers and documenting their spread in Germany. Which ways do they use? What dangers are they exposed to? Step by step, this film tells the exciting and sometimes odd success story of the likeable rodents.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Orphanage of Elephants - Nairobi Nationalpark
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm’s urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Return of the Elephants - Tsavo-East-Nationalpark
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Down to Earth - Flightless Birds
programme.desc: They’ve given up the wonderful art of flying. Or was it an art they never possessed? The brain structure and anatomy of flightless birds indicate that they descended from "flyers" – so, why don’t they fly?

programme.title: Penguin City - South Georgia
programme.desc: In the middle of the Antarctic Ocean, an entire mountain range arises from the water: South Georgia, the nursery of the Antarctic. Hundreds of thousands of penguins, elephant seals, fur seals and their young overcrowd the beaches. The rough weather and the extremely difficult access to the island cause filmmaking to be an endeavor requiring much of the film crew around Roland Gockel and Rosie Koch and the state of the art cameras. A lot of patience and sensitivity over a period spanning some five years now offers unknown and poignant insights into the life of the King Penguins on South Georgia Island

programme.title: Symphony of the Seas - Underwater Wonders of Australia's Ocean
programme.desc: Our journeys take us all around the world from Patagonia to the USA, from Greenland to South Africa and from Cambodia to Australia and leads us to the most fascinating places where landscapes animals and humans are the main focus of our documentaries. Whether on land or at sea – the last paradises of the world are our destination.

programme.title: The Last Paradises: Patagonia - Coast of the Killer Whale
programme.desc: On the wild coast of Patagonia, the nature calendar describes the most diverse visiting times of fascinating animals, from the southern right whale and other large whales, via the sea lions and elephant seals up to the orcas and millions of penguins. The encounters with whales and their babies are spectacular. Hardly anywhere else on earth can one experience both the brutal and the delightful sides of nature so vividly and so close. The trip to the hot spots for animal watchers and researchers leads us inter alia to the Caleta Valdez. This is where, during the mating season, the southern elephant seals bring their babies into the world, mate and enjoy a little sunbathing on the beach.

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature’s best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift...

programme.title: The Last Paradises: Breath of the Arctic - Wilderness North
programme.desc: This foray through northern realms of our planet above the polar circle takes us to a part of our world especially affected by climate change. The often-cited adaptability of animals could also enable them to survive under new conditions. The camera team made this foray through the polar region, from Canada to Norway, to document that, which in the opinion of many nature researchers, will no longer be visible in 30 to 50 years' time. Following the observation of ice bear mother with her young in Canada's Wapusk National Park at Hudson Bay, is a herd of harp seals on the ice during the breeding season. The Arctic Ocean ringed seals in Hudson Bay, on the other hand, prefer solitude. Should...

programme.title: Spectacular wildlife in the forests around the globe
programme.desc: A forest is like an organism, ancient and full of complex mechanics at work. Its plants need water and a specific range of temperature. And still, it can be found in the most variable places of the world. But how does it manage to adapt to the most adverse condition and still thrive? “Forests of this earth” uncovers the forest’s amazing strategies of survival, the strange phenomena that allow them to strive in varied biotopes and under different environmental conditions, and the interplay they have with the fascinating animals living in them.

programme.title: Dream Islands Of Europe: Capri, Ischia and Procida
programme.desc: Capri and Ischia are world famous. From Naples, it's just a short hop over to the two islands. Perfect destinations, then, for a week's cruise along the Gulf of Naples and the adjoining Amalfi Coast to the south. There, Positano, Amalfi or Salerno as well as a handful of other mostly small harbor towns are extremely worthwhile destinations.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Sulcis Archipelago is located off the south-western coast of Sardinia and is part of the province of of southern Sardinia. The islands of San Pietro, Sant'Antioco and Isola Piana form the archipelago, together with several uninhabited islets and rocks form the archipelago. It belongs to the less known areas in Italy and is little developed for tourism. Nevertheless stars like Tom Cruise and Roberto Cavalli come here to enjoy the peace, seclusion and good food. The islanders are only moderately interested in these visitors, and their down-to-earth attitude has never lost.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Lake Iseo is located on the southern foothills of the Alps. It extends over the provinces of Brescia and Bergamo in the northern mainland of Italy. In the middle of Lake Iseo lies the largest island of the southern European inland waters. Monte Isola, as the island is called after its central mountain lies close to its two neighboring islands, Isola di San Paolo and Isola di Loreto. As early as the 11th century, a monastic association of Benedictines settled here. For many Italians, Lake Iseo is the most beautiful spot in their homeland. It is all the more astonishing how little the influence of tourism is here. Driving is strictly forbidden on the three islands, and only on Monte Isola....

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Tuscan Archipelago is a group of islands at the height of Florence. The archipelago stretches from the Ligurian Sea to the Tyrrhenian Sea, north-east of Corsica. The archipelago consists of seven main islands - Giglio, Elba, Gianutri, Capraia, Pianisoa, Gorgona and Montecristo - and other smaller islands and rocks. Not all of them are inhabited. We look at the three most extraordinary islands of the archipelago: Elba, Capraia and the island of Montecristo. The Tuscan Archipelago is one of the most important natural wonders of the world and is protected as Parco Nazionale dell'Arcipelago Toscano. With its 61.474 hectares of protected and 17,694 hectares of protected land area, it is...

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Far from the glamour and spotlight of Lampedusa, Pantelleria is one of the best kept secrets among the Italian islands. Located closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria has been nicknamed "The Last Island," a title also given by Giosuè Calaciura gave to his 2016 historical novel set on Pantelleria. Pantelleria, that is the island of lava, capers and of the liqueur wine that comes here Zibibbo. An island with an ancient history, where for centuries farmers and fishermen have pursued their craft. their craft. The famous Zibibbo grapes are cultivated here - among other things also on the vineyard that Gerard...

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around...

programme.title: Bavaria's Alpine Kingdom
programme.desc: There are sparkling palaces from ice and snow, like those found in a fairytale. The icy castles are the phenomenal work of Mother Nature but man had a hand in the magnificent stone castles of the region. The spectacular and histrionic mountains of the Bavarian Alps challenge wildlife and the people who live there and the rocky ramparts of this mountain kingdom are built of limestone and fossil rocks that tell of its origins beneath the sea. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to Bavaria every year to witness the mysticism of the landscape. Kings and Queens, tourist and locals, all are welcomed in the fantastic alpine kingdom. Early summer often comes with the threat of...

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such...

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Wild Life, Gentle Nature
programme.desc: As contrasting as the landscapes of the 15th meridian east, so different are its animal inhabitants. What are the living conditions like in the heat of the Namibian Damaraland, in Lusatia or on the coast of Norway? Which challenges do elephants, whales or kingfishers have to master together with their companions from north to south?

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: Almost 11000 kilometres lie between the northernmost and southernmost point of the 15th meridian east. Here you will find extreme landscapes such as the shimmering heat of Africa or the eternal cold of northern Scandinavia. Five people from Spitsbergen, Namibia, Slovenia, Germany and Poland dedicate their lives to environmental protection.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Sow, Harvest, Eat – Our Conservatory
programme.desc: This episode focuses on people from five countries who share a common passion: The production of their own food and food. What culinary treasures are hidden in the different regions, from Spitsbergen to Sweden, Austria, Poland and Chad?

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 From Generation to Generation
programme.desc: The journey leads from the Norwegian Vesterålen to Chad, the Aeolian Islands and the Polish Giant Mountains. As different as the landscapes and cultures may be, all people are united in their love for their children and their desire to give something to tomorrow's generation.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference

programme.title: Nature, Space and Matter

Dr. Fred Alan Wolfexplains the origins of many of these foundational theories that have formed at differenttimes and why they came about. Before quantum physics, people knew that humanbeings were conscious. We knew that animals were conscious. But now, with newrevelations in quantum physics we begin to see a new role for consciousness.

programme.title: Across the Ice
programme.desc: After 45+ expeditions throughout over 150+ countries, one of the world's leadingadventurers and visionaries of conservation, Swedish explorer Johan Ernst Nilsondawns upon his biggest adventure yet. Follow his journey across the planet from theNorth Pole to the South Pole in Pole2Pole. The 525 day mostly carbon-neutral trekcovers 20,000 miles by means of skis, dogsled, boat, bike and kite. Pole2Pole is notonly one of the most difficult adventures he�s ever attempted, but also one of his mostphilanthropic adventures. Johan visits charities along the way to share their stories andraise global awareness.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A man walks into a gendarmerie near Saint-Malo to report that his wife has been missing since the previous day. The couple are going through a divorce, but this mother would never have left her seven children alone! An extensive search is undertaken but the woman cannot be found. What has happened to Adeline Piet? The investigation spans several years and experiences many twists.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and -an extra sordid detail - a devil mask is found next to her body. Was Priscillia the victim of a prowler? A serial killer? A maniac inspired by a horror movie? Investigators soon find that the young girl felt she was being watched, and even threatened...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: In the early hours of the morning, Mathilde Croguennec, 18, attending "Teknival" in Brittany, is found at the foot of a tree with her throat cut. Investigators face the task of finding the killer from among the 43,000 participants of this huge open-air festival of electronic music, where drink and drugs are consumed in abundance. An unusual investigation that leads the police down a number of false avenues.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written "DIRTY RAPIST". Yet Jean-Raymond Blatti was never charged with sexual assault. Over the course of the investigation, this inscription will appear as one of the many mysteries of this case which is particularly rich in twists and turns.

programme.desc: On December 20, 2012, in Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, 29, was killed on her doorstep with a bullet to the head.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devil's Plateau." What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss police's investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled. But surprisingly, though the highly meticulous murderer has taken care to leave no sign of his passage, the autopsy reveals traces of sperm on the victim. It will take all of the investigators' intuition to pierce the mystery of this heinous crime...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want the adorable hairdresser of Saint-Martin-d'Ablois dead. During the investigation, the work of profilers will enable them to draw a very precise portrait of the murderer...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Nelly Crémel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging... never to return. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. There's no doubt that it's murder. The case soon ignites public opinion, even inflaming passions at the highest level of the state. The clues lead investigators on a number of trails, from the shadows of the French secret service to a manhunt for a possible sex maniac, in a case of murder most foul.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris. It soon becomes clear that the man has been tortured prior to death. At several points during this extraordinary enquiry, police will feel they're holding the culprit... It will take them ten years to finally shed light on this particularly violent crime.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. A veritable execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of the quiet family man. programme.desc: Hauling 65 pounds of gear through the Norwegian mountains, Les Stroud must decide between staying with his vehicle or trekking for help.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "True Lies"
programme.desc: A check station outside of Billings stops a guy who refuses to tell the truth. Investigating who shot the deer reveals a long history of game violations.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "NARCOTRAFFIC POLICE PATROLS"
programme.desc: As one of the world’s top cocaine producers, Peru is a magnet for global drug cartels. To combat the trade at its source, the elite anti-narcotics unit Sinchi was formed—taking the fight deep into the heart of production zones.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "TOURIST POLICE PATROLS"
programme.desc: With one of the highest homicide rates in the world, Acapulco sees 104 murders per 100,000 people. In this deadly environment, a special anti-crime unit puts their lives on the line daily to keep the city from descending into chaos.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "EUROPEAN POLICE PATROLS"
programme.desc: In the multicultural hubs of Paris and London, tensions can run high. It’s up to the police to bridge differences and keep the peace—working daily to protect some of Europe’s busiest capitals.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "WOMEN POLICE PATROLS"
programme.desc: In Hyderabad, India, wealth and poverty coexist side by side. Each day, 15,000 officers battle crime ranging from theft to interreligious violence. In Palestine, 8,500 police face an even tougher challenge—working across a fragmented, politically tense landscape where every patrol carries risk.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "MEDITERRANEAN - HARBOUR POLICE PATROLS"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 MEDITERRANEAN - HARBOUR POLICE PATROLS
programme.desc: In Catalonia, the regional police have taken over from Spain’s national force, deploying a rapid-response motorcycle unit to tackle urban crime. Meanwhile in Haifa, Israel’s main port city, police operate under strict laws in a tense environment shaped by terrorism threats and ongoing regional conflict.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Crushed By A Boulder - Part 2"
programme.sub-title: S03 : E06 Crushed By A Boulder - Part 2
programme.desc: After his leg is crushed by a boulder, Gregg Hein is stranded on a high Sierra peak with an infected compound fracture. Knowing he won’t be reported missing for days, Gregg attempts to crawl off the mountain and rescue himself.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Iraqi Sniper Attack"
programme.desc: On deployment in Anbar Province, Marine Corp Master Sergeant Buck Doyle throws himself in harm's way to save a fallen comrade from an Iraqi sniper and becomes a target himself. This is a story of survival on and off the battlefield.

programme.title: Dropped S5 - "Fireside Fortune"
programme.desc: Using up the last of their energy, the Keefer brothers make their way down stream in search of their next supply cache. The tide turns as they finally make their way out of the open tundra and into the heart of moose country.

programme.title: Dropped S5 - "Now or Never"
programme.desc: With lifted spirits, the Keefer brothers set out to spot and stalk a herd of caribou near by, but closing in proves more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S3 - "Like Father, Like Son"
programme.sub-title: S03 : E04 Like Father, Like Son
programme.desc: In Cordoba, Argentina doves and pigeons are considered to be in plague proportions and culling them is necessary to maintain balance in the region... however, things turn a little competitive when Mario brings his dad to help.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S3 - "Iberia Truffle Ibex"
programme.desc: Mario finds the help of a local Spanish baker to lead him high into the Becite mountain after Iberian Ibex, but he must first forage for truffles in order to make a European style pasta with the offal of this cagey mountain goat.

programme.title: Emergency S1 - "Religious Fervour"
programme.desc: Massive crowds gather at Allahabad’s Maha Kumbh Mela and Manila’s Black Nazarene, creating major healthcare challenges. Thousands of medical personnel and volunteers are deployed to keep people safe.

programme.title: Emergency S1 - "Big Cities"
programme.desc: Osaka, Japan, struggles with increasing emergency calls from its aging population. In fast-paced Greater Mexico City, home to 20 million people, medical services face overwhelming demand.

programme.title: The Hunt for Monster Bass S1 - "Winter Largemouth"
programme.desc: Host Ott DeFoe hunts down double-digit Largemouth Bass in the dead of winter in Tennessee.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Head Case"
programme.desc: Someone shot and stashed the head of a trophy bull elk. Wardens spend months staking out the head. Once it is moved they use high tech equipment to locate the head and capture the suspect.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Blood Trail"
programme.desc: Wardens step into the world of CSI this week in determining where a deer was killed. But when uncovering the truth the best thing is to follow the Blood Trail.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Case Closed"
programme.desc: The illegal killing of multiple animals over the past 5 years by a family of poachers is going to trial. Wardens on on the witness stand hoping for a guilty verdict and a Case Closed.

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "The Ducks of Venice"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 The Ducks of Venice
programme.desc: Follow in the footsteps of Hemmingway and visit the son of a famous duck decoy maker, who made all of Hemmingway's decoys, and shared many mornings in the lagoon with the famed American Author.

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "Danish Dynamite & The Boar"

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "The Italian Hare"
programme.desc: Travel back to the Apennine Mountains in Italy and join a hare hunt all the way up and above the clouds.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Deputies are shocked when they recognize a repeat offender. When confronted by the cops, a desperate man shows no love for his girlfriend. Officers bring in a canine unit to complete a vehicle search.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Officers get a tip and locate the suspect in a recent shooting. A woman is questioned when she is found parked alone in her car behind closed businesses. Officers respond to a call involving juveniles spray painting an electrical box.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: ATV joyriders lead officers on an unwieldy chase. An attempt to check on some expired tags ends with a couple at gunpoint. A motorist gives deputies his brother’s name in hopes of avoiding jail time.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Despite driving a large SUV and trailer, a suspect tries to outrun the police. A driver tries to hide contraband on his person. Police are called into a domestic dispute involving a husband and wife.

programme.title: Cops

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Træt af at arbejde for sin far, starter Josh sin egen transportvirksomhed med en ny lastbil.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Militærlastbilen går i stå på den frygtelige vej til minen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Gary og sønnen finder en gammel militærlastbil, men det er hårdt at køre den op til minen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Justin flyver ind med en ny sav, men mister tålmodigheden, da han forsøger at sætte den op.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Teamet støder på endeløse problemer, mens de forsøger at skære et stykke ud af 60-fods-stenen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia ankommer med boreudstyr og har kun fire dage til at finde den bedste jade, men Robin og hende kan ikke blive enige om, hvor de skal lede.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Drengene kommer op og skændes, da tidspresset tvinger dem til at arbejde på to miner på én gang.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Teamet får jadesten op af J-linsen, men problemer med vejen truer hele operationen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Da Claudia og Robins testboringer efter jade ikke giver resultater, kan selv virksomhedens geologer ikke blive enige om en plan.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia, Robin og holdet kæmper for at få deres tunge udstyr op ad et bjerg, inden stigende floder gør det umuligt at nå minen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Spændinger opstår under teamets kamp for at transportere tungt udstyr op ad en mudret, klippefyldt, 120 km lang sti for at etablere en ny jade-mine på bjergtoppen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Teamet forsøger at få deres maskiner transportet over kraftigt stigende floder for at etablere deres nye jademine på en bjergtop.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Robin forsøger at trodse fysikkens love for at få et stort, nyt mandskabsrum til deres Wolverine-mine.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: En række uheld forfølger Jade City-holdet, og alle forsøger at finder unikke løsninger på problermerne.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Alle bliver ellevilde, da de endelig begynder at grave lovende, grønne klippestykker op, som teamet tror er millioner værd.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Spændingerne koger over, da de oversøiske investorer dukker uventet op for at tjekke fremskridtet i Wolverine-minen, og Alan forsøger at skabe fred.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Efter endelig at have afdækket nogle lovende klippestykker ved Wolverine-minen, opdager teamet, at de måske har overtrådt minens grænser.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Stressniveauet stiger i takt med at afslutningen på mine-sæsonen nærmer sig, og Jade City-teamet forsøger at finde den store jade-gevinst.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia og Robins uprøvede maskiner begynder at bryde sammen under den brutale tur op til Wolverine-minen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Teamet forsøger at krydse svulmende floder, for at få deres maskiner op til minen, mens Josh falder bagud i sin gravemaskine, der konstant har problemer.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Josh er strandet på den lange sti til Wolverine-minen, da dele af hans gravemaskine falder af og han har ikke nogen muligheder for at tilkalde hjælp.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Minensæsonen starter, og mens jaden viser sig at være svær at finde, bringer en lastbilulykke held til Jade City.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Med årets mest lovende klippe bliver bearbejdet ved Wolverine, crasher Josh og R2 deres lastbil, hvilket efterlader Claudia og teamet i chok.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Kapløbet er i gang for at komme ud af Wolverine-lejren, inden sneen begraver det hele.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Spændingerne koger over, da Claudia, Robin og teamet forsøger at få mennesker og udstyr til deres fjerntliggende jade-lejr.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia og Robin forsøger at imponere deres nye forretningspartnere, men de første dage på deres nye mine Bullion Creek, er frustrerende.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Sæsonens første store klippe bringes tilbage til lejren og savearbejdet går igang.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Justin gør krav på et nyt område, efter at han snubler over et fantastisk jadefund, men andre minefolk er også interesseret.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudias nye partnerskab er i fare, mens Justin og teamet bliver distraheret under forsøget på at flytte en gigantisk klippe, der kan være en formue værd.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Teamet kæmper for at få gang i Dynasty-jadebruddet trods defekt udstyr.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Justin og Mike kæmper med revner og hinanden for at bevise at deres metoder virker over for de utålmodige investorer.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Alan vender tilbage fra Kina og fortæller Justin og Mike de ubehagelige sandheder om den mine, de forsøger at udvide.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Justin og Mike kæmper sig gennem sne og is for at nå hen til den potentielt værdifyldte jadeklippe - Big Fin.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Vinteren ankommer til Dynasty, og teamet fortsætter med at mine indtil det sidste øjeblik.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Robin følger en mavefornemmelse til et nyt sted på et gammelt mineområde, mens Joshs' høje forventninger og korte lunte tester Garys tålmodighed.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Guy kæmper med gravemaskinen for at blotlægge et enormt fund, mens Joshs' utilfredshed med hans rolle i teamet får familiekonflikterne til at koge over.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Holdet står over for en farlig redningsaktion på bredden ved Turnagain-floden.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Bearbejdelsen af et potentielt værdifuldt fund sættes på pause, da gammelt udstyr fejler.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Arbejdet starter endelig på den gigantiske jadeklippe ved Dynasty, men store revner bringer projektet i fare.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Da en vigtig jade-køber ikke er imponeret over Pit 3-linsen, tvinges Claudia til at træffe en svær beslutning, der skuffer hendes hold.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Kapløbet for at lukke lejren ned ved Wolverine bliver til et mareridt, da varme, sygdom og en skovbrand rammer teamet.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Den brutale rejse til en ny mineområde adskiller familien og presser Josh til bristepunktet.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia er ivrig efter at påbegynde arbejdet på det nye sted, men arbejet bliver forsinket af en række uheldige hændelser i deres gamle minerlejr, Wolverine.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Lidt forkælelse i lejren opmuntrer et utilfreds mandskab, og uventede gæster giver Claudia håb for hendes fremtid ved 2 Mile.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Gary og Josh vender ikke tilbage fra en rutinemæssig brændstofshentning, og boreresultater skaber tvivl om kvaliteten af jadestenene ved 2 Mile.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK

programme.title: Together We Rise
programme.desc: A tribute to the global brotherhood that refuses to fit in. This collection celebrates the unity that turns fans into a tribe. In this pit, no one stands alone—together, we are the loudest force on earth.

programme.title: For Metalheads Only
programme.desc: Leave the rock anthems at the door—this is 100% pure steel. We’ve dialed the distortion to eleven for a lineup strictly for the heavy-duty fans. No compromises, no fillers, just total sonic devastation.

programme.title: Heavy Pumping
programme.desc: Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

programme.title: Metal That Rocks
programme.desc: Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

programme.title: Your Pulse Of Metal
programme.desc: Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.

programme.title: The Art Of Destruction
programme.desc: Founded in 1982, DESTRUCTION is a "Big Three" titan of German thrash alongside Kreator and Sodom. With uncompromising music and high-energy shows, they’ve thrilled millions. Discover the story of a global force that helped define the genre.

programme.title: From The Scene For The Scene
programme.desc: Go beyond the music and into the heart of the underground. This collection pairs heavy-hitting videos with exclusive band interviews and reports from metal capitals worldwide. Built by the scene, for the scene.

programme.title: Night Time Metal
programme.desc: The sun is down, the filters are off, and the real chaos begins. Brace yourself for the raw, uncensored side of the scene too heavy for daylight. This is the unfiltered truth of the underground. Adult ears only.

programme.title: Bay Area Godfathers
programme.desc: Discover the explosive origins of the San Francisco thrash scene. From garage rehearsals to the first club riots, see how bands like Metallica and Exodus ignited a global movement. It’s the raw, untold story of metal's birth.

programme.title: Bay Area Godfathers II
programme.desc: The saga continues as the Bay Area sound conquers the world. Witness the evolution from underground heroes to global icons through exclusive interviews and rare footage. Experience the peak of the thrash metal revolution

programme.title: Finnish Metal Special
programme.desc: From the frozen North comes a sound of haunting melodies and raw intensity. Dive into Finland’s finest, where melancholic atmospheres meet the power of the thousand lakes. It’s a masterclass in darkness and ice-cold riffs.

programme.title: Heavy Pumping
programme.desc: Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

programme.title: Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.

programme.title: Manic Ritual
programme.desc: Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled...

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: What on earth and/or sea is super fun host Kim Lallouz cooking this week for her One Big Recipe? You guessed it - Surf and Turf! First on the beach are her Singapore-inspired Chili Crab Cakes, redolent with southeast Asian aromatics and spices like lemongrass, ginger, and galangal. 'Turf's up' next with a fresh off-the-hoof Marrow Toast plate decked out with melty marrow, crispy crostini, and garlicky parsley salad. We all deserve a creamy cheesy break (right?), so of course Risotto Carbonara with Crispy Pancetta and Enoki Mushrooms follows. Braised Veal Osso Bucco is the big deal main course, all shored up surfingly with scrumptious Seared Scallops and smoky Grilled Broccoli Rabe!

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Moate in County Westmeath, is a place where football is part sport, part religion. On an overgrown plot on the outskirts of town lies the abandoned future home of county GAA All Star Dessie Dolan, his wife Kelly and their 3-year-old son Nathan. They have bought themselves a dilapidated cottage on a hopelessly exposed site in the village.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: At Sutton in North Dublin, Dermot extends a 1960s suburban house, changing a beloved childhood home into a sumptuous new one for Hannah, James and their twin sons. To give the couple the 'wow factor' they've asked for, Dermot designs a large L-shaped extension at the rear of the house with a soaring mezzanine level.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Having rented a house in Navan for the last two years, teacher Celine and sound engineer Dave are excited at the prospect of moving to a farmhouse once owned by her grandparents at Kildalkey village in County Meath where Celine grew up. The couple will be the fourth generation to live there and retaining the charm and character of the old place is a major concern for the whole family.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: In the three years since newlyweds Rosie and Keith bought their five-bed house in Templeogue, Dublin 6, they haven't changed a thing. From the dark, cold interiors to the cavity block, flat roofed extension, this house is a relic of 1970s design, with décor to match. Keen to create a unique take on the rather unimaginative suburban semi, Dermot designs a radical, steep-roofed extension...

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Country and Irish legend Daniel O'Donnell and his wife Majella share a large four bed detached home in Kincasslagh West Donegal. Unlike Daniel, who's fairly happy with the place, Majella is keen to upgrade and reconfigure the interior. With her husband on tour, she's determined to get the very best from her architect.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Nine years ago, Susie and Dave bought their dream home on the outskirts of Fermoy in Cork - a 170 year old three storey mansion that Susie has admired since she was a teenager. The house however, has begun to show its age and Susie and Dave want to extend and upgrade to create the ultimate family home.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: IT manager Christine has bought herself a red brick terraced house in Clontarf, North Dublin. Christine has big plans for the place but as Dermot quickly discovers, they're far bigger than her 130K budget will allow. And despite his best efforts, Dermot is unable to convince Christine to modify her 25 page wish list.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: At the seaside village of Portrane in North Dublin, Dermot creates a workable home for three generations of the one family under the watchful, budget-conscious eyes of two sisters.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Recently returned to Ireland after 12 years in London, new parents website designer Cliona and IT manager Micheal have already spent 30 grand renovating a 1950s semi-D at Killester in North Dublin in their own distinctive, industrial style.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Dairy farmer Padraig and schoolteacher Katie are hoping to create their 'forever' home by renovating a century-old farmhouse on a half acre of land recently inherited from Padraig's uncle. But delivering this dream won't be easy for their architect. Dermot's problems begin when he presents his initial design and it Katie announces that she has no time for 'open plan' living.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: At a 1960s 'Semi D' in Stillorgan, Dermot's vision of a million euro 'Malibu style' house for Rory and Lorna from the west of Ireland descends into an ongoing battle over the style and position of the front door.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: David and Nessa Conlon have just bought this 1990s split level detached bungalow and plan to move in with their three children (twin boys aged 11 and a 7 year old girl) once the renovations have been completed.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: In the second episode of Room To Improve, Dermot Bannon heads to Borrisoleigh, Co. Tipperary, to meet Joe Kenny and his bride to be Mary Hayes. Joe's house is a 3 bedroom, 2 storey house on a half acre site about half a mile from Borrisoleigh, with beautiful views of green fields. Mary and Joe are creating their dream home, to move into just after their wedding. Joe has lived the bachelor life up until now and his house reflects this. Dermot can see exactly why Mary is insisting on a redesign.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: In the third episode of Room To Improve, Dermot Bannon heads to Rathfarnham, where Yvonne and Adrian Saunders live with their daughter Lauren. Yvonne and Adrian's house is a detached 1950s two-bedroom property, in need of massive transformation. Dermot likens it to a 'Hansel and Gretel' house.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: In Ashford Co. Wicklow stands the house of Nigel and Frances Coffey. Frances's parents live next door. Several years ago her father built a private road and gave seven plots of land to his seven children.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Claudia and Tom bought this 1920s bungalow with panoramic views of Tramore Bay in 2012 for 305K. Just back from living abroad (Spain, Dubai and Germany) they have been living in the house for the past year.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Glenn Keating and Gustav van der Westhuizen live in Grace Park, Drumcondra, with their 5-year-old son Noah and two pet Weimaraner dogs. Glenn is a youth worker for LGBTI+ young people in the city centre and Gustav is a banker.

programme.desc: This time urban explorers Josh and Cody separately visit Germany and Morocco in search of astonishing abandoned locations including Wünsdorf, the forbidden city near Berlin, and an abandoned filmset in the Sahara desert used for Game of Thrones.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - "Georgia / France"
programme.desc: Josh and Cody are separately visiting Georgia and France. Cody, together with rooftopper Harry Gallagher, undertakes a cable car trip known as 'Stalin’s coffin'. Josh is in France searching for abandoned chateaus with globetrotter Lexie Limitless.

programme.title: Love On The Rocks S1 - "Trust Me!"
programme.desc: Jason has attempted to climb the Grand Teton, located in Wyoming, three times before the couple's adventure out west. Will the fourth time be a charm, or will life's unplanned moments present even greater challenges than Jason anticipated?

programme.title: Love On The Rocks S1 - "Hell's Revenge"
programme.desc: After climbing the Grand Teton, the couple head to Utah where a change of plans has them trading in their climbing shoes for an ATV. They take on Hells Revenge, a 4x4 trail only recommended for extremely experienced drivers...which they are not.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S5 - "Philippines"
programme.desc: Jonathan explores the Philippines, from Davao cacao farms to Siquijor’s witchcraft, volcano rides, Manila motorcycling, and flying at Fort Drum.

programme.title: Roads Unknown India S1 - "The Journey Begins"
programme.desc: Overcoming illness and the chaos of bustling Chennai city traffic, Jess rides with a diverse group through vibrant coastal towns, before venturing inland toward the mountains and the sacred town of Palani.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S1 - "CRAYFISH + KINA"
programme.desc: SYNOPSIS: In this episode, Piri Weepu heads to Tolaga Bay in search of crayfish and kina with the help of local, Richard Meihana. Piri gets a little local history from a kuia. Plus Piri and Richard pluck fresh water mussels from the river bed ahead of a whanau gathering.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S1 - "EELS + DEER HUNTING + BREAKING IN HORSES"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 EELS + DEER HUNTING + BREAKING IN HORSES
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri is in Masterton to try his hand at eeling. Plus two Martinborough locals take Piri deer hunting and show him how to break in a horse.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S1 - "WILD BOAR IN HEREKINO"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 WILD BOAR IN HEREKINO
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri is in Herekino where he meets local characters, brothers, Chad and Theo who take him on an epic pig hunting adventure.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Berg River"
programme.desc: While Xander gets an up-close look at the tranquil and isolated Kersefontein Farm, Adam becomes a true armchair adventurer, wishing he was experiencing anything besides snowy Canadian weather.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Majestic Cederberg"
programme.desc: When Adam’s power goes out in Winnipeg, he decides to spend the day building a snow fort. Meanwhile, Xander and his crew take a trip through Cederberg.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "From Elands to Lamberts Bay"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 From Elands to Lamberts Bay
programme.desc: Up next, Xander and his team stop to surf the legendary left break at Elands Bay. After experiencing the peace and tranquility of the ocean with South African locals, Xander and his team hit a snag in their journey.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S1 - "Japan and New Zealand"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 Japan and New Zealand
programme.desc: When you’re Australia’s most popular vet, what do you do next? If you’re the charismatic, hard working Dr Chris Brown, its time to shut the surgery and start exploring some of the world’s most beautiful and sometimes bizarre places, people and animals.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S1 - "South Pacific Paradise"
programme.desc: In this episode of Travels With the Bondi Vet, Chris visits a city with more pets than children, experiences a 3-hour holiday in this south pacific paradise and goes on a 600 kilometer journey in the Australian outback to deliver some mail.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S1 - "Australian Islands and Abu Dhabi"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 Australian Islands and Abu Dhabi
programme.desc: In this episode of Travels with the Bondi Vet, Chris finds an Australian island with some unusual locals, finds out how fast he can go in futuristic Abu Dhabi, tags along on an extreme four wheel drive day trip and finds out why the Color Run is taking over the world!

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - "Germany / England"
programme.desc: Josh and Cody are diving into the underworld. This time, Josh explores the abandoned German mining industry, including an encounter with a Police squad, and in England, Cody explores an old Soviet submarine in the English Medway river.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - "U.S.A. / Cyprus"
programme.desc: Cody encounters wild animals and thrilling attractions in abandoned Six Flags, New Orleans. Meanwhile, Josh is in Cyprus where the UN peace keeping force allows him to explore the abandoned Nicosia International Airport and the UN bufferzone.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - "Armenia / Greece"
programme.desc: Together with rooftopper Elaina Hammeken, Josh explores an incredible radio telescope from the Soviet era in Armenia while Cody experiences an astonishing trip through the Greek mining industry of Ptolemaida with his travel companion, Elvis Brauer.

programme.title: Love On The Rocks S1 - "Deserts and Mountain Lions. Oh My!"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Deserts and Mountain Lions. Oh My!
programme.desc: Hiking and canyoneering are a nice break from strenuous mountaineering, but it's hard to relax when a lack of water and mountain lions are part of the equation. Tayler and Jason both need a break...but is the break they need actually from each other?

programme.title: Love On The Rocks S1 - "Marriage Highs"
programme.desc: Tayler and Jason reconnect during a romantic stay in Lake Tahoe, but Jason struggles keeping his cool while off roading the Rubicon Trail. Are Jason's high expectations too? And will these expectations shut them down on their next climb, Mt Whitney?

programme.title: Love On The Rocks S1 - "Alpenglow"
programme.desc: Jason and Tayler attempt to summit the highest peak in the continental US, Mt Whitney. However, during their time on ascent they run into some unexpected surprises that leave this mountain attempt one they will never forget.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S5 - "Season Recap"
programme.desc: Jonathan recaps the season, sharing disasters, blunders, lessons learned, and never-before-seen clips from his adventures.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S1 - "DIVING FOR KINA AT RANGIPUTA"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 DIVING FOR KINA AT RANGIPUTA
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri Weeps heads North to Rangiputa. Guided by locals Wikatana and Sandy, the trio hit the water for a kina dive. Plus Piri gains some insight on a rahui established in Ahipara.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S1 - "TROUT FISHING THE TONGARIRO"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 TROUT FISHING THE TONGARIRO
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri heads to Turangi to go fly fishing on upper reaches of the Tongariro River only accessible by white water rafting.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S1 - "KINA CREW"
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri is in Wellington with his dive team, the ‘Kina Crew’. The boys hit the west and southern coastlines to collect kai moana ahead of their annual ‘AGM’.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "Wild Paternoster"
programme.desc: Adam and Xander go on fishing trips on opposite sides of the globe; one in a winter wonderland and the other in Paternoster, an old South African fishing village.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "Kraalbaai Caribbean"
programme.desc: While Xander and his team experience the joys of wakeboarding in the beautiful Kraalbaai Caribbean, Adam attempts to replicate this experience.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Langeberg Mountains"
programme.desc: The South African crew travels to the Langeberg Mountains for a luxurious day of relaxation and exploration while Adam searches for wildlife on his makeshift Canadian safari.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Borneo"
programme.desc: Chris travels to the stunning rainforests of Borneo, where he encounters endangered Orangutans and the extremely rare pygmy elephant.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "The Rockies"
programme.desc: Chris sets out to learn about Canadian Wolf dogs, takes a trip on the world famous Rocky Mountaineer, and strikes out in search of black bears.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Adelaide and Brisbane"
programme.desc: Chris encounters knife jugglers, hula-hoopers, and giant pandas, takes an oyster challenge and tests his mettle against the world’s hottest burger!

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - "U.S.A. / Belgium"
programme.desc: While Cody explores lost industries in the ‘ugliest’ city in the world with freerunner Abudi Alsagoff, Josh, together with his old neighborhood friend John Yurei, is in the famous American prison 'Joliet', where prisoners build their own cells.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - "Norway / Croatia"
programme.desc: Josh and urban exploring-legend Steve Duncan travel to the arctic island of Spitsbergen, Norway, where there is an old Soviet mining town waiting to be explored. Meanwhile Cody explores the dark and cruel history of Goli Otok prison in Croatia.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - "Namibia / Albania"
programme.desc: Cody is in Namibia following in the footsteps of German diamond seekers hearing stories of thieves and smugglers. Josh is in Albania and finds abandoned fighter jets and a secret factory.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Kenya's Great Grasslands"
programme.desc: Bicycling is a safe and leisurely activity, until you decide to do it through the wilderness of Kenya with large lion, elephant and buffalo populations.

programme.title: YEAR OF THE HORSE Zodiac Girls’ New Year Heights
programme.desc: This zodiac year, the ancient idiom "MaDaoChengGong" promises that success will gallop right to your door. Our culture host, Julian Waghann, saddled up to meet some young equestrians whose personal quests might just teach us all how to leap into our own lucky year! Take a look.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.1: Old Gems
programme.desc: Xiamen, a key starting point of China’s ancient Maritime Silk Road, is one of China’s most livable cities. In this episode, host Min-Zhui Lee and co-host Pan William, an honorary citizen of Xiamen and a professor, take you on an immersive journey through the city. Trace Xiamen’s history through its streets, admiring the arcades that tell the stories of the city’s early commercial development. programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. programme.title: Young drummer of Ansai
programme.desc: Soaring leaps and the energetic beats of the Ansai waist drum dance made Gao Yuchen, a nine-year-old boy, fall in love with the dance at first sight. Growing up in Ansai, Shaanxi, Gao was first drawn to the large-scale folk dance while watching a local performance. As a form of intangible cultural heritage, the Ansai waist drum dance was promoted by local authorities and was included as part of his school's PE program. Gao was able to receive waist drum dance training as an extracurricular activity at his school, and he subsequently became a rising star on campus. He says he wants to become a better dancer and hopes to perform on bigger stages.

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes.In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.”The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests...
